reported that Baowu - China’s largest steelmaker - is considering a stake of between 15% and 25%, which would come from BHP's share of the project. Reuters sources did not give a ​potential valuation or other details.
BHP owns 85% of the Jimblebar mine, with Japanese trading houses Itochu and Mitsui owning minority stakes.
